meta.title: Borrow Half To Buy A Stock, And You Can Lose More Than 100% Of Your Cash
meta.hook: Borrow half the money to buy a stock, and you can lose more than everything you put in.
meta.description: Margin trading lets investors borrow against their brokerage account to buy more stock than their cash alone would cover. Federal Reserve Regulation T caps that initial loan at 50% of the purchase price, and FINRA rules require investors keep at least 25% equity in the position afterward. If a stock drops enough to breach that floor, the broker can force a sale — sometimes at the worst possible moment — and because the loan doesn't shrink with the stock price, losses can exceed the original investment. Educational content only, not financial advice.
